introduction: CAPK Food Bank supplies a network of food distribution locations across Kern County. Start by finding an active site near you.
description: CAPK Food Bank supplies a network of food distribution locations across Kern County. Start by finding an active site near you.

sections.who: People needing food can request a local referral. Individual distributions may have different participation conditions.
sections.get: Available groceries depend on the distribution and stock. This service is separate from CalFresh cashless grocery benefits.
sections.docs:
• Location and transport needs.
  • Ask the site about any household or identification information.
sections.apply:
1. Find food

    Call 211 or800-273-2275 using the contact listed on CAPK Food Bank.

  2. Confirm the distribution

    Check date, time, access and any registration requirement.

  3. Collect food

    Follow the site’s instructions and bring carrying bags if useful.
sections.after: Ask about the next distribution and alternatives if food runs out.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using CAPK Food Bank. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Should I visit the warehouse for food?
Confirm an actual distribution location first.
Are all sites open every day?
Is the same food always available?
Items depend on stock and the site.
